Received from ACKO

Design inputs.

These inputs have shaped the revised proposal.

  1. Align the color and material palette with the updated design direction (Lean nordic).

  2. Provide more variety in breakout spaces.

  3. Ensure every neighborhood has a dedicated collaborative space.

  4. Increase the size of the podcast room & Green room

  5. Revise the Boardroom to meet the required capacity. Location to be relooked.

  6. Move meeting rooms toward the center of the floor plate rather than along the façade.

  7. Rework the cafeteria location, considering the unavailability of plumbing provisions.

  8. Explore the landscape deck as an additional functional and breakout space.

  9. Crash/nap room: mandatory

  10. Sick room with a bed, privacy and first aid: mandatory

  11. Dealers room to be added

  12. Mail room to be provided

01. Concept framework · 2 offices

Moving offices is easy. Moving people isn’t.

Two offices. One campus.

About 651 Ackers, from two workplaces, onto one floor. A campus lets every team keep a home of its own, while everyone belongs to the same place.

we came from two……we arrive on one floor…

    Biophilia

    Where people gather, CO₂ gathers. The heat shows where breathing out concentrates: the desks, the café, reception, the lift lobbies and the meeting rooms. Service rooms (server, UPS, battery) are counted as sources too.

    Planting where it's needed. The plants are placed where people gather, and the busiest spots soften around them.

    Conceptual: fresh air with CO₂ sensing carries the load; the planting supports air quality and wellbeing.

    Green in view. Planting placed in the line of sight from the desks: a glance at green, all day, to lift the mood.

    Acoustics

    Four levels of treatment, matched to how loud and how private each space is. Hover a level to find its rooms.

    The rings show sound: wide and lingering in the open workhall, cut short in the treated rooms.

    • NRC 0.70–0.90 across the floor
    • Ceiling treatment in meeting rooms for RT60
    • Absorptive wall panels for speech clarity
    • Full-height partitions to the right STC
    • HVAC noise held to zone NC targets
    • Sound masking, so focus holds
    • Acoustic doors and double glazing

    An acoustic consultant can refine the specification.

    What we Stand for

    Quality

    We consistently meet and strive to exceed the agreed upon requirements of our clients.

    The quality plan involves:

    • Monitoring and constantly updating work progress
    • Inspections and quality tests at regular intervals
    • Surveillance and on-site inspections

    Sustainability

    We are conscious of reducing our carbon footprint and use sustainable materials and products.

    • Use of adhesives, paints with low VOC content
    • Recycling of construction waste
    • Use of recyclable materials
    • Use of non-urea formaldehyde materials

    Safety

    From site instructions to training and audits, we implement a full-proof safety strategy

    • Use of materials and gears according to safety standards
    • Implementing safety instructions
    • Guidelines displayed on site in multiple languages
    • Dedicated safety team with certified members
